description: Explain a failed terragrunt run's errors and how to fix them with an AI model

env.help: API key for the chosen provider.
env.name: PIPELINES_HOOK_AI_ERROR_ANALYSIS_API_KEY

flags.help: Who serves the model. For anthropic, the hook configures the model to check Terragrunt fixes against the Terragrunt docs, through their MCP server.
flags.name: provider

flags.help: For example: 'claude-sonnet-5' on anthropic, 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5' on openrouter.
flags.name: model

flags.help: Most tokens the model may write, thinking included.
flags.name: max-output-tokens

flags.help: Log verbosity. A more verbose PIPELINES_LOG_LEVEL overrides it. One of: trace,debug,info,warning,error,fatal,panic.
flags.name: log-level

name: ai-error-analysis
title: AI Error Analysis
